risk_tiers.LOW: no flags, no broken rules, credit_score >= 700 and existing_loans <= 1
risk_tiers.MEDIUM: passes all hard rules but has a flag, or is just outside the LOW limits
risk_tiers.HIGH: any default, credit_score < 650, more than 2 loans, FOIR above the limit, salary credited below 60% of net pay, or an edited / reused document
